t2.thesis: SNDK enters the print after a memory-sector run-up on SK Hynix's results, with a large implied move and a recent record of sell-the-news reactions, so the odds of a rise are near a coin flip.
reasons: Semis cluster base rate (0.479) sits below the overall ~54%, which pulls the prior down.
Last 4 prints: only 1 of 4 rose at the next open, with -16% and -5% after huge EPS beats, a sell-the-news pattern.
Entry at the open on 10/29 follows a sector rally (SK Hynix, Micron) that has already priced in good news; Seagate fell despite a beat.
Offsetting this, guidance was strong (Q1 EPS $44-46 vs consensus ~$46.4), estimates are being revised up, the forward P/E is about 5, and the stock is 40% off its high with low short interest.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether the fiscal Q2 revenue and EPS guide clears the elevated buy-side whisper (above ~$46-50 EPS) and confirms NAND pricing and NBM momentum.

prior.from: I3: semis cluster t0_hit 0.479 (n=434), AMC session 0.538, overall validation 0.542; blended to about 0.52 for a semis name reporting AMC

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-10-28, so that earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how SNDK's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Started at 0.52 from the semis/AMC base rates. Pulled down about 0.02 for the poor recent reaction history and the sector run-up into the print, then back up about 0.00 for upward estimate revisions and the cheap valuation. Net 0.50.

theses.expected: Rise: revenue and EPS beat and the Q2 guide is well above consensus on NAND pricing and new NBM agreements.
theses.mechanism: Memory shortage commentary from SK Hynix supports pricing; a low P/E and the pullback from the high give room for a re-rating.
theses.wrong_if: The guide is only in line, or gross margin has plateaued around 84-85%.

theses.expected: Fall: sell-the-news despite a beat, as in the last two prints.
theses.mechanism: The stock ran up into the print on SK Hynix, so expectations are high and the 8% implied move leaves little room for an in-line beat.
theses.wrong_if: The stock gaps up even though the beat is modest.

theses.expected: Mixed: the open gap is small relative to the 8% implied move.
theses.mechanism: A beat balanced by cycle-peak concerns about pricing leaves the reaction dominated by call commentary.
theses.wrong_if: The guide surprises decisively in either direction.

key_observations: Q2 revenue and EPS guide vs the ~$46-50 whisper
Datacenter revenue growth and new NBM signings
Buyback pace and commentary on NAND supply and pricing
